mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park under a full moon, with an overnight low of 53 degrees and no rain in the forecast.

The city has announced that a portion of Highway M near the future Aldi site will be closed from October 5 through October 7 for final paving and road improvements. Additionally, ongoing work continues as part of the broader Aldi development project which involves traffic shifts and utility upgrades in the area.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by a full schedule of trivia nights and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market taking place this coming Tuesday.

Looking at the most recent departmental reports, on September 5, officers were called to investigate a series of reports regarding cheese slices being placed on vehicle windshields, which was identified as a viral social media prank.
Today's flavor of the day is the ever-popular Turtle. The store is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10 PM tonight, so stop by soon to enjoy your dessert.
